title: Resilient Mean
prompt: Write mean(texts) that receives a list of strings. Convert each to a number; strings that cannot convert are skipped. Return the mean of the converted values as a float. If NOTHING converts, raise ValueError with the word 'empty' in the message. Print mean(values) for values = ["10", "x", "20", "", "30"] — one line, formatted :.2f.

tests.name: skips bad, returns mean
tests.code:
assert abs(mean(["10", "x", "20", "", "30"]) - 20.0) < 1e-9, f"got {mean(['10', 'x', '20', '', '30'])}"
assert mean(["4"]) == 4.0, "single value works"
assert abs(mean(["5", "5", "5"]) - 5.0) < 1e-9, "all valid works"
tests.hint: int(t) in try/except; accumulate valid values then divide.

tests.name: raises when nothing converts
tests.hint: count what converted; if count == 0: raise ValueError('empty ...')
